claim: A nested reduced and full sampling plan supports staged field work, but fewer samples do not guarantee equivalent mapping or variogram performance; both alternatives require separate feature-space and spatial QA.
conditions: The reduced plan is a strict subset of the full plan; added full-plan locations target spatial infill or short lags.
limitations: The value of added samples depends on target variability, laboratory quality, access constraints and the eventual model.
recommended_action: Report sample count, soil-class proportions, covariate quantile coverage, maximum spatial gaps, nearest-neighbour distances and pair-distance distributions for both plans.
not_allowed_action: Do not state that the reduced plan guarantees the same map quality as the full plan.
